Simulate fleet effort

Source: R/effort.R
effort_sim.Rd

Nominal effort \(E_{f,y}\) is the trend times multiplicative lognormal noise with mean one, \(\exp(\epsilon - \sigma_E^2/2)\), \(\epsilon\sim N(0,\sigma_E^2)\). The noise is drawn once per fishery and iteration, so all species share it. Efficiency (effort creep) is \(\eta_{f,y} = (1 + c_f)^{\max(0, y - y^c_f)}\); it scales fishing mortality but not the nominal effort index.

Usage

effort_sim(fishery, nsim = 100, seed = fishery$seed)

Arguments

fishery

a fishery().

nsim

number of iterations.

seed

random seed; default the fishery's seed, so repeated calls give the same effort.

Value

a list with FLQuants

effort (nominal) and efficiency, one element per fleet, each FLQuant(age = "all", year, iter = nsim).

Examples

eff <- effort_sim(reef_fishery(), nsim = 5)
eff$effort$traps
